name: BBC Weather: Lisbon

frame.part: top of the page, no scrolling

capture_note: Captured by incident.archivist@ (evidence bbc/2026/11/11/0252-weather-2267057) and kept privately: the site's terms do not clearly allow showing a screenshot, so the frame stays empty and the link stands.
licence_for_showing_the_screenshot: BBC terms: no reuse without permission. The screenshot is shown only if the archivist's reading of its terms allows; otherwise the frame stays empty and the link stands.
summary: Dinis's reference for the weather face. One sentence, day tabs, an hour row, a map with a time bar. And, for Lisbon on the eve of IPMA's red warnings, no warning at all.

callouts.title: The place, and nothing else, as the title
callouts.does_well: "Lisbon" over a weather photograph; one button to keep it.

callouts.title: One sentence for the period
callouts.does_well: "Tonight: Thundery showers and a gentle breeze", with the low. A whole forecast in six words.
callouts.fed_by: incident.json (headline, standfirst); the sentence must come from the authority, see callout 7

callouts.title: Day tabs with high and low
callouts.does_well: Eight days in a row; the selected day is joined to the card.
callouts.fed_by: incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/forecast.json (daily.days) with each day's warning colour from warnings.json

callouts.title: The hour columns
callouts.does_well: Hour, symbol, temperature, chance of rain, wind speed in a circle with its direction. Tap an hour for more.

callouts.title: Last updated
callouts.does_well: "Last updated today at 23:02", small, under the hours.

callouts.title: A map with a play button and a week of time
callouts.does_well: Rain over a satellite-style base map, a time bar from Wednesday to Tuesday, "Long forecast" and "Pressure" views.
callouts.fed_by: none we may show (imagery.json): links to IPMA's radar and EUMETView, or our own warnings map

callouts.title: What is not there: any warning
callouts.does_well: No banner, colour or word about IPMA's red wind and rain warnings for the next day; the sentence says "a gentle breeze". A model without the authority. Our page starts where this one is silent.
